GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) is vendored here from the official npm
package `gsap@3.15.0` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap), fetched via
`npm pack gsap` during development.

Per gsap's package.json: "Standard 'no charge' license:
https://gsap.com/standard-license." — GSAP and all of its plugins became
free for all use (including commercial) after Webflow's 2024 acquisition
of GreenSock. See that URL for the full license text before redistributing
this project.

Only the core gsap.min.js build is vendored - no plugins (ScrollTrigger,
Draggable, etc.) are used or included, per
.claude/skills/gsap_animation_authoring/SKILL.md's rule against
scroll/drag-dependent animation in a non-interactive video capture context.
